mentions.name: JavaScript in-memory database
mentions.description: An original in-memory database written in JavaScript that stores and searches data via objects and arrays, aiming to execute faster than existing solutions while feeling natural to JavaScript.
mentions.problem: Dislike of SQL and a belief that existing solutions execute slower than possible while feeling unnatural to JavaScript.
mentions.source_excerpt: I am going to write an original in-memory database in JavaScript. I hate SQL and believe I can write something that executes faster than existing solutions while also feeling natural to JavaScript: storage and search via objects and arrays.
